notes: Pre-seed date and amount are not published anywhere found; the entry is dated only as before the Oct 2024 seed (company incorporated 2023-07-12: Ameba Systems Ltd, Companies House 14997742). Seed $7.1M (GBP 5.3M / EUR 6.4M) led by Hedosophia with Visionaries Club and Anamcara (tech.eu, eu-startups, UKTN, Yahoo/TechCrunch copy 2024-10-02). The later seed is a named Seed, so it does not count as graduation from the pre-seed. Visionaries principal Isabella Yamamoto quoted. HQ: 116 Commercial Street, London (company site footer). Focus: the product is an AI extraction/agent layer (AI & Applied AI); a SaaS reading is possible.
